description: This PHP source file implements a captive portal webpage for WiFi device configuration, including security measures (CSRF protection), localization, UI management, and network configuration logic. It features client-side JavaScript for user interaction, validation, and network checks, as well as server-side PHP for retrieving device info, session management, and access control.

methods.name: getStr
methods.description: Retrieves a string value from device parameters, used for localization and configuration

methods.name: KeyExtGet
methods.description: Retrieves extended configuration data for device parameters

methods.name: getParaValues
methods.description: Fetches parameter values for specified device components

methods.name: DmExtGetInstanceIds
methods.description: Gets instance IDs for device object collections
